request: Read DebugAI active protected policy nonsecret metadata and local canonical sync without mutation; determine real admission path

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'DEBUGAI_POLICY_SOURCE_HEAD='
git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_ACTIVE_POLICY='
f=/home/admin1/.config/debugai-gitops/delegations/policies/dlg_master_debugai_v1.json
if test -r "$f"; then jq -c '{id,enabled,revoked,allowed_operations,allowed_scopes,benchmark_path_allowed:(.allowed_paths|index("server/control/model-ab-benchmark.js")!=null)}' "$f"; else echo NOT_READABLE; fi
printf 'DEBUGAI_LOCAL_REGISTRY='
f=/home/admin1/server-core/operations/master-internal-repositories.json
if test -r "$f"; then jq -c '.repositories[] | select(.id=="dlg_master_debugai_v1") | {allowed_operations,benchmark_path_allowed:(.allowed_paths|index("server/control/model-ab-benchmark.js")!=null)}' "$f"; else echo NOT_READABLE; fi
